brief: Strong visual inspiration from Lando Norris, with Apple/Linear control clarity, adapted to genuine Hotel Augusto photography and a universal booking enquiry dock. Do not clone reference branding, assets or claims.

method.browser: One headless Microsoft Edge process, sequential1440x1000 and390x844 contexts for each site; loaded fonts and rendered screenshots; browser closed after captures.
method.source: agent-reach web route through Jina Reader plus direct public HTML/CSS fetches.
limits: Two static scroll positions per viewport do not establish continuous animation smoothness, pointer behavior, complete page performance or accessibility conformance.
No third-party scripts were copied into Augusto. Public CSS was inspected for design evidence only.
Lando primary h1/h2 computed measurements are hidden1x1 text and must not be treated as visible display measurements.
Reference factual claims and date labels are not hotel facts.

sources.observed: Image-dominant portrait hero; mobile controls recomposed; a dark next chapter with photograph and oversized type bands; persistent compact controls.
Brier bold and Mona Sans Variable declared; width/weight variation used for visible headings; strong brand-specific dark-green/lime palette. Not proposed for reuse.
Left-aligned type, dominant product canvas, precise gutters, quiet borders and utility controls.
Inter Variable regular family, header72px desktop/64px under640px, page padding24px, reduced-motion overrides on view transitions.
Mobile menu opacity entrance/exit0.18s gated by prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; header link transitions limited to color/background.

patterns.observed: The hero subject occupies most of the first viewport. The brand and utility controls live around that subject; the next content does not compete for attention.
patterns.augustoAdaptation: Use one genuine hotel room photograph as a near-viewport canvas. Anchor a short confident heading asymmetrically, retain small location context, and let the fixed dock handle the booking pathway.
patterns.avoid: Do not copy the portrait cutout, lime palette, race plaque, floating wireframe cap, or tap-to-lock interaction.

patterns.observed: A full dark chapter changes the canvas. Oversized horizontal type and a central portrait create a deliberate layered composition. Mobile keeps the photograph prominent.
patterns.augustoAdaptation: Use a single ink-blue Varanasi chapter with a broad genuine river photograph and oversized decorative KASHI behind it. Keep functional headings and copy readable above the image.
patterns.avoid: Do not crop meaningful text or introduce racing motifs; only aria-hidden decorative lettering may crop.

patterns.observed: Lando moves store/menu and wordmark positions on mobile. Linear uses a measured38px/41.8px heading rather than simply shrinking the entire desktop page.
patterns.augustoAdaptation: Compose room image crops independently at390px; account for header plus booking dock before choosing hero height. Keep major text, room evidence and a clear pathway in the initial usable viewport.
patterns.avoid: Do not make a tall introductory text block consume the entire mobile viewport or scale a wide room photograph into an unreadable thumbnail.

patterns.observed: Compact fixed header, low-contrast rules and restrained pill control; short menu opacity transitions are disabled for reduced motion.
patterns.augustoAdaptation: Keep Inter for forms/navigation. Use stable52px booking controls, visible labels/focus states and short180-250ms feedback. Keep heavy motion away from data entry.
patterns.avoid: Do not copy13px controls or low-contrast text when the hotel audience needs larger readable inputs.

patterns.reference: Lando layered chapters plus Linear restrained interaction CSS
patterns.observed: Distinctive image/type layers provide a spatial composition; Linear public CSS limits many control transitions to color/background and gates mobile menu animation by preference.
patterns.augustoAdaptation: A small bounded image offset or scale may reward pointer/native scrolling. Room hover/focus can reveal another genuine photo while the room name/CTA stays stable. Manual city tabs crossfade between real images, with immediate static states under reduced motion.
patterns.avoid: No scroll hijacking, loading gate, perpetual carousel, forced lock gesture, WebGL dependency or hidden essential content.
